title: Bodies brought to Gaza hospital after deadly Israeli strike
description:
(29 Jul 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

++CLIENTS NOTE: EDIT CONTAINS GRAPHIC CONTENT++

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Khan Younis, Gaza - 29 July 2026
1. Various of medics and people carrying bodies of killed men to the morgue, placing them on the ground 
2. Various of relatives crying and mourning the killed inside the morgue 
3. Various of woman mourning her killed brother 
4. Various of injured man, his clothes covered with blood, lying on bed inside emergency department and crying
STORYLINE:
At least three Palestinians were killed and over a dozen others were injured in two Israeli airstrikes in Gaza City and southern Gaza on Wednesday, local health officials said. 

A drone strike on a civilian vehicle in the Remal neighborhood of Gaza City killed one person, according to health officials at the Shifa hospital, where the body arrived. 

Another strike near a tent camp in southern Gaza’s Khan Younis area killed two people and wounded over 16 others, according to health officials at Nasser hospital and the Palestinian Red Crescent Society.

Footage from the hospitals showed relatives mourning the deceased men. 

The Israeli military claimed it struck "two military operatives,” without elaborating. 

The strikes are the latest in a series of attacks carried out almost daily by Israel on Gaza since a ceasefire deal between Hamas and Israel came into effect in October 2025. 

Israel claims it is targeting Hamas and other militants posing a threat against it.

Over 1,200 people have been killed by Israel in Gaza since the ceasefire deal was reached, according to the Hamas-run Health Ministry, which doesn’t differentiate between civilians and combatants. Its figures are viewed as generally reliable by the international community.

Since October 2023, Israeli attacks have killed over 73,000 Palestinians, according to the Gaza Health Ministry.
